text:
alex: Heads-up from QA: the rollback toast is confusing in the new timeline flow. It says "Rollback applied" but doesn't indicate which version or whether traffic shifted gradually. Users hit it and ask where the "undo" is.
marta: Thanks. We should experiment with a compact + detailed pattern: compact toast + anchor to timeline entry that expands with full metadata. Keeps screen real-estate tidy.
kevin: Implementation notes: we can add a url fragment like `#history:entry-<id>` so the toast CTA navigates to the timeline drawer. Need to confirm deep-linking semantics with routing.
maya: Accessibility: make sure the toast text is announced by aria-live=polite and the timeline panel announce is separate (aria-live=assertive?) — careful, assertive can interrupt. Prefer polite for both but announce the timeline open with a SR-only heading that contains version + humanized time.
sam: Copy brainstorm: Option 1: "Rollback complete — serving v202 (100% traffic)". Option 2: "Rollback executed: v202 rolled back into service (100%)". Option 3 (short): "Rollback to v202 — view history". I like 1 for clarity.
lina: Micro-interaction: the toast can show a tiny propagation progress bar (animated 0-100% over 3s) to signal backend reconciliation. For reduced-motion users we should hide the bar and swap to a static label.
kevin: Good call. We'll respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS and set reduced animation. Also will expose an endpoint property `rollout_state` so UI can show propagation rather than guess.
marta: UX questions: should the 'Undo' live inside the toast or only in the timeline? Undo in toast encourages immediate revert but can be easy to misclick. Timeline Undo can show diff before applying. Proposal: toast has a single 'View history' CTA; timeline shows 'Undo' with confirmation modal.
alex: +1. Also, change the toast duration to 12s and make it dismissible with Escape and by clicking the X.
maya: A11y nit: timeline selected background is currently `token-bg-2`; contrast ratio with body copy is 3.1:1. Need to update to `token-bg-3` to get >=4.5:1. I'll add the token names to the accessibility checklist. Also SR should read "Version 202, rolled back by @jordan, 2 minutes ago" — avoid raw ISO strings.
sam: Tiny copy ask: change the canary control 'Pause' tooltip to 'Pause new traffic to variant' so product managers don't misinterpret it as stopping everyone.
lina: I'll update Figma: new toast variants (compact, compact+chevron, compact+progress) + timeline anchor micro-interaction (200ms fade). Include reduced-motion frames.
designbot: Action items: update toast copy, add history anchor link, toast duration to 12s, prefers-reduced-motion frames, timeline token update, humanized timestamps, move Undo to timeline with modal confirmation.
kevin: I'll file the infra ticket for rollout_state and deep-link support.
marta: I'll create the design task and attach the figma once ready. thanks all :thumbsup:
